Hi Mina,

Hope you had a good holiday — quick ask from our procurement and security teams as we head into contract renewal for the clinical data pipeline. We need the following to complete the security evaluation and procurement checklist: 

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (covering what period?).
- A bridge letter (if the audit period doesn't extend through our renewal date).
- Completed SIG questionnaire (spreadsheet) and CAIQ answers.
- Auditor contact (for validation) if available.

Our renewal target: contract signature by 2028-02-15. Procurement prefers evidence that coverage extends at least until 2028-03-31, or a signed bridge letter that explicitly covers the gap.

Could you confirm what you can provide, any redaction norms, and an estimated delivery timeline? I attached our procurement requirements spreadsheet (procurement_timeline_acme.xlsx).

Maya — thanks for the clear checklist and timeline. We can support this, and here is what I can commit to immediately: 

- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2027_redacted.pdf (we will provide a redacted PDF of our most recent Type II covering 2027; redactions limited to customer names and IP where required).
- Draft bridge letter (we can produce a signed bridge letter covering interim period through a mutually agreed date).
- Completed SIG spreadsheet and CAIQ (we have an internally completed SIG v2 and CAIQ; we can export them for you).

A couple of clarifying questions so we align the artifacts with procurement expectations:
1) When you say coverage through 2028-03-31, do you require a bridge letter with an explicit end date of 2028-03-31, or would an attested timeline plus an operational statement from our CTO be acceptable for procurement?
2) Scope: do you need SOC 2 coverage for production only, or both production and any preview/beta endpoints?
3) For SIG/CAIQ, do you require the original auditor notes or just our completed answers and controls mapping?

Proposed delivery timeline (assuming we get confirmation on scope):
- Draft bridge letter & redacted SOC2: by 2028-01-12.
- SIG v2 and CAIQ export: by 2028-01-10.
- Final signed bridge letter (DocuSign): by 2028-01-18.

I will loop in Legal (Laura) and Sales Ops (Ben) while we finalize language around the bridge attestation. If procurement needs the auditor contact, I can provide our auditor's name and email subject to NDA (we typically provide contact info for validation calls).

Next steps: please confirm answers to Q1–Q3 and whether procurement wants the bridge attested to 2028-03-31 specifically. Once confirmed we’ll push the artifacts to the Drive link and start the DocuSign flow.

Best,

Thanks Mina — answers below so we can move fast:

- Q1: Procurement will accept a signed bridge letter explicitly stating coverage through 2028-03-31. The letter must indicate which controls are subject to the bridge (full SOC 2 scope preferred).
- Q2: Production coverage only; call-outs for preview/beta are helpful but not required.
- Q3: Completed SIG and CAIQ answers are fine; no auditor notes required unless we flag a discrepancy.

Milestones for our side: 
- Procurement final review deadline: 2028-02-01.
- Legal & security executive sign-off: 2028-02-10.
- Contract signature target: 2028-02-15.

Also — please include a quick control map (one-pager) that maps your SOC 2 controls to the SIG families; that speeds review. If you can route the bridge letter via DocuSign, we will countersign the same week.

Appreciate the timelines you proposed.

Best,

Maya
